title: Qt: Add Browser SSL keylog dialog
description:
Adds a menu under Tools to launch a browser with the SSLKEYLOGFILE environment variable set.

Remove "browser_sslkeylog.lua".

1. Should this update the preference `tls.keylog_file` or should there be a reminder in the gui that the user needs to do that?  
  
A tooltip for file path or a help button on the popup window?  
  
2. Opening then closing the window causes Wireshark to hang (briefly) on exit.

> Should this update the preference `tls.keylog_file` or should there be a reminder in the gui that the user needs to do that?

The preference is updated (saved) if (and only if) the user presses "Save".

> Opening then closing the window causes Wireshark to hang (briefly) on exit.

Need more info.

Would this be ok in the hint area?  
"TLS keys will be logged to this file. Click Save to update preference."

Including log here but not specific to the ssl browser window.  
Can recreate just by opening and closing gui.

Is this related with this change? Are you using the SSL Keylog dialog in any way after you start Wireshark? If so how?

No. Sorry - I was testing the SSL Keylog dialog so thought the lag was related to it.  
After more testing I can recreate just by opening/closing the Wireshark welcome screen.  
I thought there were some recent issues where people thought Wireshark was laggy with newer versions and was going to check if what I see is related.  
  
So the only thing that I would like to add to the SSL Keylog dialog is a more verbose hint, hover tooltip or Help button to indicate that Launch does not update setting - the Save button is required for that. I'm probably a worst case user where I was excited to test the change and just went straight to Launch without thinking about saving changes for next run of Wireshark.
Some hint to save changed preferences would be useful. I don't think a static message like you suggested is the way to go personally.
Maybe the dialog shouldn't close itself when "Launch" is pressed, allowing the user to optionally hit "Save" before "Close". What do you think?
That would be great. A way to kick the tires / check it out before having to commit.
Great. Done in !11801.
resolved all threads

It might make sense to rename this to something like "SSL Keylog Launcher" since it might be useful to launch other types of programs, e.g. a terminal application. I can create a MR that does that if no one objects.

commits_data.title: Qt: Add Browser SSL keylog dialog
commits_data.message:
Qt: Add Browser SSL keylog dialog

Adds a new menu under Tools to launch a browser with the
SSLKEYLOGFILE environment variable set.

Adds a new GUI preference to store the browser path specific
to the SSL Keylog dialog (which may be different from the user's
preferred system browser).
